title: Triage bucket says 0 actionable while doctor sees 351 actionable in the same directories
body: Reproduced twice on 2026-08-31, after each 100-player claude_code wave: playtest-loop's post-wave triage prints 'bucket: 0 actionable of 633-ish' and 'Nothing promoted to intake/queue: no ticket is corroborated or verified yet' — while its own tally line in the same run reports 351 corroborated clusters, and 'npm run doctor' run moments later against the same qa/tickets + intake/queue directories reports 'tickets 635 (351 actionable)' and a dev loop that has work. Wave-2 numbers: Triaged 302 sessions (249 with interview): 829 issues -> 633 clusters; verified 0, corroborated 351, accumulating 284, stale 351; bucket: 0 actionable of 635; doctor: tickets 635 (351 actionable). Either the loop's bucket/promotion check reads a different notion of 'actionable' (e.g. requires verified, or reads a different store/worktree path) than the doctor, or promotion is silently gated on something corroboration does not supply — adjacent to the open 'verified rung is unreachable / nothing supplies verifiedTicketIds' finding (queue id f26bbd36141140f0), but this one is about the corroborated rung. Root-cause which counter is right and make the two tools agree; a promoted-work pipeline that reports 0 while holding 351 corroborated findings is the audit's 'nothing promoted looks identical to broken pipeline' failure mode happening live.
